description: v3: Planner + conductor (codeg-cli), parallel child tasks, round caps restored
changelog: A started task is now driven by a conductor sub-agent (arbor.py conduct), launched and supervised by the Planner session; roles run through the default codeg-cli command executor. Child tasks run in parallel, one conductor each. Round caps (gate, review, polish, no-progress) enter STOP again and are handled as escalations; tasks already past a cap STOP on their next round and continue with arbor.py resume. New config section: conductor:.
